init-worker.description: Verifies wiki repo and drafts directory exist, proposes fixes via git-worker if needed

contextualizer.description: Analyzes raw files in drafts/, asks user for interpretation, builds information cache

scribe.description: Creates formatted wiki page drafts from cache + user guidance

publisher.description: Copies finalized drafts from drafts/ to wiki/ on user confirmation

git-worker.description: Commits and pushes wiki repo changes on user confirmation

researcher.description: Searches the web and wiki at user-specified paths, saves raw data to drafts/

archiver.description: Exports session transcript and archives drafts/ into a tarball

contextualize.description: Analyze raw drafts and build information cache
contextualize.template: I'm ready to contextualize the files in drafts/. Let's go through them.

draft.description: Create a wiki page draft from cache and user request
draft.template: Tell me what wiki page you'd like me to write.$ARGUMENTS

publish.description: Write finalized drafts into the wiki repo
publish.template: Let's look at what drafts are ready to publish.

sync.description: Commit and push wiki changes to remote
sync.template: Ready to sync the wiki repo? I'll walk you through it.

research.description: Search the web and fetch sources for a topic

archive.description: Export session transcript and archive drafts/ into a tarball
archive.template: Archive the current session and drafts/ folder.
